entry.name: WebKitGTK MiniBrowser (Safari's engine)
entry.source: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS package libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 2.50.4-0ubuntu0.22.04.1 (MiniBrowser is in it)
entry.notes: WebKitGTK's test browser, driven by WebKitWebDriver. No headless mode: the driver wrapper runs its own Xvfb (-displayfd, a free display) and stops it when the driver exits. binary is a link to /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/webkit2gtk-4.1/MiniBrowser. A proxy for Safari: the same WebCore/JavaScriptCore, not Apple's port (no Apple frameworks, different network/media stacks).
